name: venturepulse
description: VenturePulse — Validate. Analyze. Improve. A startup idea validation platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix backend && npm run type-check --prefix frontend
